From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Connor <sarah.connor@acmecorp.com>, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Decision pathways & CEO invite timing — ACME close plan

Sarah / Tom —

Thanks again for the constructive meeting yesterday. We want to keep momentum and lock a final decision window that aligns with your exec calendar. Two quick asks to finalize the close timeline:

1) Confirmation of the decision pathway you prefer (single-day exec review vs two-step approvals). I sketched two options below.

2) CEO availability windows — ideally a 45–60 minute slot the week of Aug 30 or Sep 6 for a brief exec-level review + sign-off. If the CEO isn't required, please confirm the highest-level approver instead.

Proposed options (high level):
- Path A — Single executive review (CEO or COO): 45 min presentation + Q&A; procurement signs same day. Target close: within 48 hours of exec meeting.
- Path B — Two-step (Exec review -> Legal / Procurement review): Exec meeting triggers a 3-business-day procurement/contract loop; target close: 5–7 business days.

I've attached MAP_v3.xlsx (mutual action plan with owners/times) and a one-page EB invite draft. Internally I'm copying Marissa (customer success) to propose the EB attendee roster, Ben for commercial/discount approvals, and Priya for contract handoffs.

High level ask: Sarah — please indicate which path you prefer and 2–3 candidate windows for the CEO (or alternate exec) the weeks of Aug 30 or Sep 6.

Thanks —

Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
Email: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai | Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0143

Attachment(s): MAP_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet), EB_invite_draft.pdf (PDF)
From: Sarah Connor <sarah.connor@acmecorp.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@acmecorp.com>, Acme Procurement <procure@acmecorp.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Aug 2027 10:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Decision pathways & CEO invite timing — ACME close plan

Vivek —

Thanks — good summary. Quick notes from our side:

- We prefer Path A if we can lock a single executive decision. That will speed things and simplify procurement.
- CEO is likely available on Sep 2 (afternoon) or Sep 8 (morning).
- Tom (COO) asked that Procurement be included earlier in the loop so they can pre-clear a few standard clauses; I've looped them in.

I'll confirm precise times by EOD Friday. If Sep 2 works, we can aim for a 11:00–12:00 ET slot for the exec review.

Sarah Connor
VP Product & Strategy — Acme Corp

Team —

Quick internal play to prepare if Sarah confirms Sep 2 at 11:00 ET (we should be ready to run Path A):

Action items (owner / done-if):
- Marissa: Finalize EB attendee roster (max 7 seats). Include CTO, Head of Data, and one business sponsor. Deliver by Mon 8/23 EOD.
- Ben: Prepare commercial fallback for immediate close (standard discount matrix + one-off credit ask). I need verbal approval threshold for signing day (who can sign). Deliver draft by Mon 8/23 noon.
- Priya: Pre-load contract summary with redlines we anticipate and confirm procurement contact at Acme (Tom / procurement email). Attach Contract_Summary_annotated.docx.

Notes: If CEO can't do Sep 2, have Sep 8 morning as backup. Also prepare a 10‑minute technical appendix for the EB (Marissa to own).

I'll draft a short agenda and the EB invite language once the roster is confirmed.

Thanks — Vivek

Acknowledged. Quick responses:

- Discount: I can approve up to 10% day-of-close for this deal. Anything >10% needs Marissa + revenue ops sign-off.
- Credit: We can offer a one-time onboarding credit equivalent to one month of committed usage (subject to legal).
- Legal/Contract: Priya — I'll sync with you on the annotated summary; we should anticipate a two-hour turn from their legal if Procurement pre-clears the three clauses I flagged.

I'll prepare the commercial fallback deck and a one-slide summary for the EB. Target to share by Tue 8/24 EOD.
